label: Kitchen equipment (electric)
description: Generic electric kitchen equipment. Enter annual electricity use to compute tCO2e/year using the portfolio electricity carbon intensity.

inputs.label: Annual electricity use
inputs.help: Enter the estimated annual electricity consumption for this equipment (or group of equipment).

inputs.label: Electricity carbon intensity
inputs.help: Grid carbon intensity used to convert kWh into emissions. If the portfolio has a default for this, it will be used instead.
